item.title: Popocatépetl (Mexico) - Report for 28 October-3 November 2026 - Continuing Eruptive Activity
item.description:
The Centro Nacional de Prevención de Desastres (CENAPRED) reported that eruptive activity continued at Popocatépetl during 28 October-3 November. The seismic network recorded 12-55 long-period events per day that were accompanied by steam-and-gas emissions.

Source: Centro Nacional de Prevención de Desastres (CENAPRED)
